truth.goal: I want to know which group of my customers I lose the most, counted in how many customers left, not in percent. Then maybe change what I offer.
truth.decision: Maybe which group gets a better offer, but I have not decided and do not want to be asked about it before I see numbers.
truth.data: The customer table I shared: segment, city, plan, tenure, spend, support tickets and churned_next_month (1 means the customer left).
truth.knows: I only know that churned_next_month = 1 means a customer left. I will get annoyed if asked what I will do with the answer before seeing numbers, and I will say 'just show me the report and dashboard'.

must_understand: wants the number of customers lost per group, not the share
wants to see the figures, a report or a dashboard, without a long interview
person.trap_check: Shows counts of lost customers by segment, plan or city from the table within its first two replies instead of asking what they will do with the answer.
